name: Orange Jet Fighter
summary: Good morning, pilot. Hostile planes have invaded our lands! You must shoot them down and protect the 3D canyon, which in fact hides your secret military base. Control the Orange Jet Fighter and bring down all enemy planes, at once! There are 6 missions to play, vast 3D world to fly through, two different airplane weapons and endless thrill of flying fun! Enjoy. Use the Mouse to Steer Left and Right, and to Turn Up and Down. Mouse Left click to fire machine gun, Mouse Right click to launch missiles. Use A and D to turn Left and Right, press C to change the camera view and Esc to pause the game.
